prompt: In which year did Melbourne's Monash Gallery of Art (MGA) rebrand and become the Museum of Australian Photography (MAPh)?
answer: Melbourne’s Monash Gallery of Art (MGA) rebranded as the Museum of Australian Photography (MAPh) in **2023**. The official launch took place on **19 March 2023**.
